paragraphs.text:
As you turn and run, a sheet of cold lances over your shoulder. 
It is close enough to numb your ear and cheek. You feel tiny, 
razor-sharp ice crystals on your jawline.

Make a Dodge roll for yourself and Norman: if you both succeed, go 
to 513; if you both fail, go to 332; if Norman fails, but you succeed, 
go to 336.
